# Chip

```tsx
import { Chip, ChipGroup, ChipMenu, chipVariants, formatChipValues } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para selecionar uma ou múltiplas opções dentre uma série de opções disponíveis.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<StoryChip {...args} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Chip component: Size (Small / Medium) × State (Default / Hover / Disabled) × Active × Menu, with Show Icon. The paddings are the Figma ones: 6px (Small) / 10px (Medium) around the content, 2px (Space/100) before the icon and after the chevron, 6px around the label. The Figma stroke sits inside the frame, so it is an inset ring that takes no space.

## Variants

`chipVariants` (cva):

| Prop | Options | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `sm`, `md` | `md` |
| `active` | `false`, `true` | `false` |

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ChipProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active?` | `boolean` | Figma Active: the selected chip, with the Accent fill. A Menu chip is Active while it has `values`, unless this is set. |
| `icon?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Icon: the 16px leading icon. |
| `menu?` | `boolean` | Figma Menu: shows the Chevron Down. Render the chip as the trigger of a Dropdown, Popover or Bottom Sheet (`render={<Chip menu />}`), or use ChipMenu for the multiple-selection Dropdown. |
| `values?` | `readonly string[]` | Menu: the picked options' labels. They replace the label (`children`), joined by ", " up to `maxLength` characters, then "+X". |
| `maxLength?` | `number` | Characters of `values` shown before "+X". |

`ChipMenu`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value?` | `readonly string[]` | The picked options' `value`s. |
| `mobile?` | `boolean` | Figma Mobile=True: the options open in the Bottom Sheet. |
| `header?` | `React.ReactNode` | Dropdown Show Header (a search field or any slot). |
| `footer?` | `React.ReactNode` | Dropdown Show Footer (actions or any slot). |

`ChipGroup`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Group label (Figma .Label). |
| `helpText?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Text Help". |

## Types

`ChipMenuOption`, `ChipProps`

## Rules

- Import `Chip` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
